name: claude-sandbox-notebook-acp
description: Vendored npm closure for claude-sandboxed --marimo mode: the Claude Code ACP adapter plus the stdio-to-websocket bridge marimo connects to.

comments.adapter-pin: 0.39.0 is the last claude-agent-acp that returns the dedicated ACP `models` field (SessionModelState) and implements `session/set_model`. marimo's agent panel (<=0.23.x) reads that field and renders nothing when it is absent; 0.40.0+ moved models into generic `configOptions`, which marimo does not consume. See notebook.rs / the memory note.
comments.sdk-override: 0.39.0 bundles @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.156, whose model catalog predates Fable 5. The catalog the panel shows is whatever the SDK reports via initializationResult.models, so we override the SDK to 0.3.198 (Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5). Stays within 0.3.x, and both 0.39.0 and 0.55.0 read the same {value,displayName,description} model shape, so the override is a data bump, not an API change.
